#!/bin/bash
set -e
set -o pipefail

# Define directories
INPUT_DIR="/mnt/data3/zhangjy/extend_bioGen_test/output/GSE241583_atac_seq_leesang_et_al_round1/01_fastp"
OUTPUT_DIR="/mnt/data3/zhangjy/extend_bioGen_test/output/GSE241583_atac_seq_leesang_et_al_round1/02_alignment"
INDEX_BASE="/mnt/data3/zhangjy/extend_bioGen_test/reference/hg38_genome/hg38"

# Define binaries
BOWTIE2_BIN="/mnt/data3/zhangjy/extend_bioGen_test/output/envs/GSE241583_atac_seq_leesang_et_al_round1/atac_env/bin/bowtie2"
SAMTOOLS_BIN="/mnt/data3/zhangjy/extend_bioGen_test/output/envs/GSE241583_atac_seq_leesang_et_al_round1/atac_env/bin/samtools"

# Define sample prefixes
SAMPLES=(
    "U-937_vehicle_rep1"
    "U-937_vehicle_rep2"
    "U-937_LAA_rep1"
    "U-937_LAA_rep2"
    "U-937_ATRA_rep1"
    "U-937_ATRA_rep2"
    "U-937_LAA+ATRA_rep1"
    "U-937_LAA+ATRA_rep2"
)

# Loop through each sample and run alignment in the background
for SAMPLE in "${SAMPLES[@]}"; do
    echo "Aligning ${SAMPLE}..."
    R1="${INPUT_DIR}/${SAMPLE}_clean_1.fastq.gz"
    R2="${INPUT_DIR}/${SAMPLE}_clean_2.fastq.gz"
    OUT_BAM="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${SAMPLE}_sorted.bam"
    LOG="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${SAMPLE}_bowtie2.log"
    
    ${BOWTIE2_BIN} -x "${INDEX_BASE}" -1 "${R1}" -2 "${R2}" -p 3 --very-sensitive 2> "${LOG}" | \
    ${SAMTOOLS_BIN} view -bS -h -@ 2 - | \
    ${SAMTOOLS_BIN} sort -@ 2 -o "${OUT_BAM}" -

done

# Wait for all background jobs to complete
wait
echo "All alignment jobs completed successfully."
